_comment: The laboratory's own features: the tests of the generator. They add to the selection
of the template pack (kibo-template-viper) through resolve.py's `extra`, and require
LibraryReads is a library's own reads, compiled by applications of both usages: it requires nothing, so that the application's Base, which it compiles against, is not rendered beside it.

Test.doc: What it takes to put a unit to the test.

TestApp.doc: The programme that runs the test over the whole model.

TestBridges.doc: Stand-in implementations of every pool function, returning the default of its type, so that the test programme links on any model.

LibraryReads.doc: A library's own reads over an AttachmentGetting, in its own namespace, built on the application's infrastructure (shop), its Base only.
